assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study is ordered
The Holter monitoring study is coded CPT 93226
The Holter monitoring study is used to evaluate for intermittent arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The service is medically necessary to correlate recurrent syncope and near-syncope with potential underlying cardiac rhythm abnormalities
The service directly addresses the denial under PR-204
The service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
